segments.x: interesting thing is there is a different rate of inflation for every industry or sector.
So currently India experiences about a 5-6% inflation rate and that is across the country
but different industries they have they experience different inflation rates.
So for example medical inflation today is 14-15% so that means every year our medical

text: interesting thing is there is a different rate of inflation for every industry or sector. So currently India experiences about a 5-6% inflation rate and that is across the country but different industries they have they experience different inflation rates. So for example medical inflation today is 14-15% so that means every year our medical bills are going to increase by 14-15% on a compounded basis.
